charts.title: HD 191939 c: orbits around HD 191939
charts.description: The orbits of HD 191939's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 191939 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 28.580474 d

charts.title: HD 191939 c: its transit
charts.description: HD 191939 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (83, 85, 86) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 269701147, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 17-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 17-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
